title: Quantile recovery from a cumulative value
statement: For real numbers $\alpha$ and $t$, if $\Phi(t)=\alpha$, then $Q(\alpha)=t$.
replaced: Let $\Phi(t)=\int_{-\infty}^{t}e^{-x^2/2}/\sqrt{2\pi}\,dx$, and let $Q(\alpha)$ be $\inf\{s\in\mathbb R:\alpha\le\Phi(s)\}$ for $0<\alpha<1$ and $0$ otherwise. For real $\alpha,t$ satisfying $\Phi(t)=\alpha$, one has $Q(\alpha)=t$.
